# tenable-axi

Investigate Tenable One exposure and run explicitly guarded writes.
Use `npx -y @knowttl/tenable-axi` without a global install.
Bare `--version`, `-v` and `-V` print the package version.

Run npx -y @knowttl/tenable-axi config path; configure a profile with accessKey and secretKey SecretRefs.
Credentials use environment/file SecretRefs, never inline secrets or chat.
Only `https://cloud.tenable.com` is supported.

Start with local discovery:

```sh
npx -y @knowttl/tenable-axi
npx -y @knowttl/tenable-axi home --help
npx -y @knowttl/tenable-axi auth status
```

Configured home reads up to five live exposure cards.
The optional session hook reads local profile context only.
Install integrations only on explicit request through `npx -y @knowttl/tenable-axi setup hooks`.

Writes require a file profile's allowWrites and exact operation allowlist, preview, --execute and the exact preview --confirm string.
TENABLE_AXI_READ_ONLY=true overrides all write policies.
Never replay an unknown mutation outcome; follow its audit ID and read-back guidance.
Users, roles, access control, credential minting and arbitrary HTTP are unavailable.
Downloads require an explicit new output path; results are bounded, validated and redacted.

Lists default to bounded windows; preserve profile, filters, sort and fields when resuming a cursor.
Use a command's --help for required selectors, defaults and examples.
See the [command reference](https://github.com/knowttl/tenable-axi/blob/main/docs/commands.md) for all flags.
